introduction: I like software that works beautifully on both sides of the screen. A clear interface should be supported by equally thoughtful architecture, so the experience stays useful as it grows.
approach: My approach is personal and collaborative: understand the problem, ask the right questions, and make deliberate decisions. From the first sketch to the final handoff, I keep the details connected to the bigger picture.
checklist: Direct communication, from the first conversation
Clear feedback and a shared understanding of scope
Full source code ownership at handoff
Thoughtful testing across the complete experience
Useful documentation for what comes next
